coverage_notes: Supplementary recall only; the authoritative nationwide production collector was not accessed or modified.
Twelve targeted fresh-web searches returned results covering all four miss classes. No search or source-request failure that materially compromised this bounded search was observed.

No new, date-verified qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was found in 2026-10-26T23:46:55-07:00 through 2026-10-27T00:47:08-07:00. Search result publication/crawl recency was not treated as a confirmed incident date.
Only/sole/full-service grocery results were stale examples, including Ogden IA (2019), Eagleville TN (2021), and previously reported grocery closures; no new qualifying closure verified.

Distribution and pantry searches mainly surfaced older incidents such as El Paso TX storm-related on-site distribution closure of September 25, 2026, and Ruby's Pantry shutdown of April 2026; not new to this observation interval.
SNAP/WIC official interruption searches returned older benefit-policy or 2025 shutdown reporting, with no newly substantiated access-interruption notice.

Potential US Virgin Islands SNAP food-replacement item from Virgin Islands Consortium was dated October 25, 2026, well before window; it describes seeking approval for replacement of spoiled food after electrical outages, not a new SNAP benefit issuance/EBT access interruption. Excluded as older and outside this narrow recall scope. Source: https://viconsortium.com/vi-government/virgin-islands-bryan-seeks-snap-food-replacement-assistance-after-wapa-outages--says-new-generation-will-take-time
